predecessors.name: Kingdom of Poland
predecessors.text: Łęczyca and its castles, set aside by Bolesław III's testament as the dower of his widow Salomea

successors.name: Duchy of Silesia
successors.text: 'her province of Łęczyca reverted to the Senoriate' (Salomea of Berg page)

ledger.x: 1138: Bolesław III's testament sets aside Łęczyca as the dower of his widow Salomea of Berg.
1144: Salomea dies and her province of Łęczyca returns to the Seniorate.
1144: the dower ends with Salomea's death and the land passes to the Seniorate Province.

certainty.note: A dower of a town, castles and towns, with no boundary on any page opened; the extent is Cliopatria's.
